clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn gives hunters the Horn of Echeyakee. Sounded among the ancient kodo remains northeast of the settlement, it calls the legendary white predator of the Barrens.

Hunters who are being tested in the hunt receive the horn. Its call summons Echeyakee, whose name means “Whitemist” in Taur-ahe. Taure n hunters revere the king of the savannah cats as both mercy and death. He strikes so swiftly that his quarry feels neither terror nor suffering. The horn belongs at the predator’s lair, among giant kodo bones behind the hills northeast of the Crossroads.
